n: After Bill nearly met fiery doom because his Real Chute could not stop his capsule's screaming descent, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he strapped some spare boosters from Jebediah's Junkyard onto his car and flew into the boardroom one afternoon, terrorizing the already traumatized directors with savage screams and his wafer-thin heatshield. KSC engineers hastily added a drogue chute to their otherwise successful Real Chute design.
s: After Bill nearly met fiery doom because his Real Chute could not stop his capsule's screaming descent, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he strapped some spare boosters from Jebediah's Junkyard onto his car and flew into the boardroom one afternoon, terrorizing the already traumatized directors with savage screams and his wafer-thin heatshield. KSC engineers hastily added a drogue chute to their otherwise successful Real Chute design.
t: 在经历了一次 Real Chute 无法阻止指令舱呼啸坠落、险些烈火焚身的大难不死后，Bill 强烈要求做出改变。KSC 同样以成本为由置之不理，直到某天下午，他用 Jebediah's Junkyard 淘来的废弃助推器绑在车上直接冲进了董事会，伴随着野兽般的咆哮和薄如蝉翼的隔热罩，吓傻了本就惊魂未定的董事们。KSC 工程师只得在他们原本大获成功的 Real Chute 设计上匆忙加装了减速伞。

KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he returned with a BACC, a lighter, and an empty bottle of Scotch. s: After Bob almost splattered against the walls of a descending capsule whose instantly-deploying, one-size fits all parachute ripped off, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he returned with a BACC, a lighter, and an empty bottle of Scotch. Terrified, KSC engineers invented the Real Chute, which is highly configurable gradually deploys.
t: 在一次返回中，由于瞬间展开的“均码”降落伞直接扯脱，Bob 险些在指令舱内被压成肉泥，随后他便强烈要求整改。KSC 以成本为由无视了他的诉求，直到他拎着一台 BACC 助推器、一个打火机和一瓶喝光的苏格兰威士忌再次登门。KSC 工程师们被吓破了胆，连夜发明了 Real Chute——高度可配置且支持渐进展开。

n: Originally founded by Wenkel Kerman in KY 450 to commercialize his vapor-compression refrigeration units for domestic use, the company now develops and manufactures air conditioning and thermal control systems for the aerospace industry. More recently, it has entered the spacecraft recovery systems market through innovative new products by its subsidiary, RealChute Aerodynamic Deacceleration Recovery Systems.
s: Originally founded by Wenkel Kerman in KY 450 to commercialize his vapor-compression refrigeration units for domestic use, the company now develops and manufactures air conditioning and thermal control systems for the aerospace industry. More recently, it has entered the spacecraft recovery systems market through innovative new products by its subsidiary, RealChute Aerodynamic Deacceleration Recovery Systems.
t: 该公司最初由 Wenkel Kerman 于 KY 450 年创立，旨在将其民用蒸汽压缩制冷机组商业化，如今致力于为航空航天工业开发和制造空调与热控系统。近来，它通过其子公司 RealChute 气动减速回收系统的创新产品进军了航天器回收系统市场。
